fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Front Driveway; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Dense Vegetation; Landscaped Area; Vehicle Parking Area
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Limited Visibility
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the driveway to allow full-width vehicle access for emergency apparatus.
• Cut back dense vegetation that narrows or obscures the walking path between the driveway and the front door.
• Clear a continuous path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without pushing through vegetation.
• Thin dense plantings near the exterior walls of both structures to allow responders to move around the buildings on foot.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored items so responding units have a usable staging area on arrival.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly so it is identifiable at night or in reduced visibility conditions.
• Trim shrubs or tree limbs that block the view of the front door or detached structure from the driveway approach.

wildfire.conditions: Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Large Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Limited Vegetation Separation; Vegetation Along Driveway; Single Access Route; Ground Vegetation; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster closest to the structure to create more open space between the trees and the building.
• Remove or trim shrubs growing directly against or within a few feet of the structure.
• Trim low-hanging branches on large trees near the structure so branches do not extend over the roof or walls.
• Clear ground vegetation growing up close to the base of the structure on all sides.
• Thin scattered trees and shrubs around the structure so there is more open ground visible between plants.
• Cut back or remove vegetation growing along both sides of the driveway to keep it passable and reduce crowding.
• Trim overhanging branches along the driveway so vehicles, including emergency trucks, can travel the full length without obstruction.
• Keep the driveway surface clear of fallen branches, leaves, and other debris that could block access.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to locate from the road, especially under smoky or low-visibility conditions.
• Remove dead branches and dry ground vegetation from beneath large trees near the structure.
• Separate shrub groupings near the structure so there are visible gaps of bare ground between them.
• Clear vegetation growing close to any outbuildings, sheds, or detached structures on the property.
